selected_experiment.question: Of the roughly 955,782 substitute->make edges per deep-list case inside isValidChar_UInt32, how many consequentially distinct make-construction shapes are actually present?
selected_experiment.shape_abstraction: make tag + arity + shallow child tags; variable indices and literal payloads are abstracted only for diagnostic counting

classification_rule.small_stable_basis: same dominant make shape in both cases, <= 16 sampled classes, top-8 coverage >= 99%, and dominant class count >= 50000

post_result_policy.if_small_stable_basis: compile shape quotient separator and prospectively test direct construction reuse/representation compression for the dominant class
post_result_policy.if_distributed_shapes: compile obstruction against a small substitute->make shape basis and reclose

claim_boundary: Diagnostic-only shape quotienting. Abstracted shapes are not semantic equality keys and do not authorize construction reuse.
